exposure: Early-life events such as birth mode
cohort: Two independent cohorts: the Belgian Flemish Gut Flora Project (FGFP; N = 1106) and the Dutch LifeLines-DEEP study (LLDeep; N = 1135), combined with global datasets (N combined = 3948)
finding: Early-life events such as birth mode were not reflected in adult microbiota composition.
